title: Free eBay Listing Software: What's Actually Free in 2026
summary: What free eBay listing software actually exists in 2026? See which eBay tools are free, which third-party tools only offer trials, and when to upgrade.
body_markdown:
Free eBay listing software is available through eBay’s own Seller Hub, bulk listing tools, and AI-powered listing features, but third-party listing software generally requires a paid subscription after a free trial.


Here’s what’s actually free in 2026, what you’ll pay for, and how to decide when it’s time to upgrade.


## Main Takeaways


- **eBay offers 250 zero-insertion-fee listings per month** for most sellers without a Store subscription. Additional listings generally cost $0.35 each, and selling fees still apply.
- **Seller Hub includes free bulk listing tools** that allow sellers to create, edit, relist, and manage multiple listings at once.
- **eBay’s AI listing tools can save time.** Magical Listing helps generate listings using photos, while Magical Bulk Listing can create multiple drafts.
- **Third-party listing software isn’t free forever.** Vendoo and PrimeLister offer limited free trials, while List Perfectly and OneShop require paid subscriptions.
- **Free eBay tools don’t support crosslisting.** Sellers using multiple marketplaces need additional software or must manually recreate listings and manage inventory.
- **Vendoo offers a 14-day free trial** to test crosslisting, inventory management, and automation before committing to a paid plan starting at $14.99 per month.


## What’s Actually Free When You List on eBay


eBay provides several free listing tools that help sellers create, manage, and update inventory without purchasing additional software. These tools are especially useful for beginners and sellers who operate exclusively on eBay.


### **250 Free Listings Per Month**


Most eBay sellers without a Store subscription receive **250 zero-insertion-fee listings each month** . This means you can create up to 250 eligible listings without paying an upfront insertion fee.


💡 **Tip:** Remember that eBay listings automatically renew every 30 days, and each renewal counts toward your monthly free listing allowance. This means that 250 free listings doesn't necessarily mean you can list 250 new items every month. If you already have 250 active listings, their renewals will use your monthly allowance unless you sell or remove some of them.


After exceeding your monthly allowance, eBay generally charges $0.35 per additional listing.


However, getting free *listings* doesn’t mean free selling! eBay still collects a final value fee when an item sells. In most categories, this is approximately 13.6% of the total sale amount, plus a per-order fee of $0.30 or $0.40, depending on the order total.


These fees vary by category, subscription, and selling circumstances. Check out Vendoo’s[eBay Fee Calculator](https://vendoo.co/ebay-fee-calculator) to determine eBay selling fees.


### **Seller Hub and Bulk Listing Tools**


eBay Seller Hub includes a free eBay bulk listing tool that allows sellers to create, revise, relist, and manage multiple listings simultaneously.


Instead of opening every listing individually, sellers can select multiple items and update supported details in bulk.


For larger inventories, Seller Hub Reports supports uploading listings using CSV or Excel spreadsheets. This allows sellers to prepare listing information offline and upload multiple items together.


The tools are free, but preparing spreadsheets, matching required fields, and correcting upload errors can be time-consuming.


### **Magical Listing and Magical Bulk Listing**


eBay also offers AI-powered tools designed to reduce the time required to create listings.


- **Magical Listing** in the eBay mobile app allows eligible private sellers in the United States, United Kingdom, and Germany to upload a photo and receive AI-generated suggestions for categories and item specifics.
- **Magical Bulk Listing** takes this concept further by allowing sellers to upload multiple photos through Seller Hub and generate listing drafts in bulk.


These tools can speed up listing creation, but sellers should always verify AI-generated titles, descriptions, and item specifics before publishing.


## Free Trials of eBay Listing Software


Third-party eBay listing software generally isn’t free indefinitely, but some platforms offer free trials or limited guarantees that allow sellers to evaluate their features before paying.

**OneShop:** Offers paid listing and reseller automation software starting at $45 per month. *Not free.*


**Vendoo:** Offers a 14-day free trial so sellers can explore crosslisting and inventory management before subscribing. Paid plans start at $14.99 per month, with annual billing discounts available. *Not free forever.*

## Free vs. Paid: When Free Tools Stop Being Enough


eBay’s free listing tools work well for sellers managing inventory on one marketplace, but they become less practical as a resale business grows and expands across multiple platforms…


### **Free eBay Tools Only Work on eBay**


Seller Hub is designed specifically for eBay. If you also sell on Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, or other marketplaces, you’ll need to recreate your listings on each platform manually.


That means uploading the same photos, copying descriptions, entering measurements, selecting categories, and completing item specifics repeatedly. This becomes *ridiculously tedious.*


For sellers managing hundreds or thousands of listings, this creates hours of unnecessary work.


### **No Sale Detection Across Marketplaces**


One of the biggest challenges of selling on multiple marketplaces is keeping inventory synchronized.


If an item sells on Poshmark, eBay doesn’t automatically know that it’s no longer available. You must manually locate and remove the corresponding eBay listing.


Failing to do so can result in a double sale, forcing you to cancel an order and potentially affecting your seller performance.


💡 **Tip:** Vendoo offers sale detection and automatic delisting so when an item sells on one marketplace, Vendoo automatically removes it from others!


### **Bulk Listing Still Requires Manual Work**


eBay’s spreadsheet-based bulk listing tools are useful, but they require preparation.


Sellers must organize inventory data, follow the correct formatting requirements, and troubleshoot missing or incorrect information.


Free tools can handle basic bulk tasks, but they don’t provide the same centralized workflow as dedicated reseller software.


**The biggest difference between free and paid listing software isn’t simply how quickly you can create a listing. It’s how much ongoing inventory management you can automate. 🎯**

## The Best Free eBay Listing Software Depends on Your Selling Needs


eBay’s own listing tools are the only truly free option for sellers in 2026. Seller Hub, bulk listing features, and AI-assisted tools provide plenty of functionality without an additional software subscription. However, sellers managing inventory across multiple marketplaces may benefit from additional automation. A free trial is the best way to evaluate paid software before committing.


## Free eBay Listing Tools FAQ


### **Is there free eBay listing software?**


Yes! eBay offers free listing software through Seller Hub, including bulk listing tools, spreadsheet uploads, and AI-assisted listing features. These tools don’t require an additional software subscription.


### **How many free listings do you get on eBay?**


Most eBay sellers without a Store subscription receive 250 zero-insertion-fee listings per month. After exceeding this allowance, additional listings generally cost $0.35 each.


### **Does eBay have a free bulk listing tool?**


Yes! eBay Seller Hub includes a free bulk listing tool that allows sellers to create, revise, and relist multiple items simultaneously. Seller Hub Reports also supports CSV and Excel uploads for managing larger inventories.


### **Is Vendoo free?**


Vendoo is paid reseller software with a 14-day free trial. Plans start at $14.99 per month, or $12.49 per month with annual billing.


### **What’s the best free crosslisting app?**


There isn’t a permanently free third-party crosslisting app among the major options compared here. However, Vendoo offers a 14-day free trial to test crosslisting across 10+ marketplaces. For sellers listing exclusively on eBay, Seller Hub remains the best completely free option.
